digest.component_or_area: LLM configuration and model class system
propositions: Rebar's per-pass model tier selection is inferred from equality tests against the framework default, causing silent downgrades to stop applying when operators specify non-default Bedrock model IDs
The single REBAR_LLM_MODEL knob cannot express per-tier provider/model mappings, and model_ladder bare names in YAML resolve to direct Anthropic instead of the configured provider on Bedrock runs

A REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE pointer must deep-merge table configuration (preserving sibling keys) and replace array chains wholesale, but the existing read_reserved_section helper uses shallow merge that loses provider and fallback settings

Class names (trivial/standard/frontier) must resolve at three independent call sites (step config path, batch runner ladder expansion, verifier path) via a single function to prevent cross-provider drift during plan and code review passes

Per-pass model routing must survive provider boundary crossings, such that Pass-1 escalation uses frontier tier while Pass-2/Pass-4 verifiers use standard tier, even when configured for different providers
